data.name: Jawfiya
data.gender_notes: Jawfiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root j-w-f, meaning to be gentle, kind and to treat with tenderness. This name evokes images of delicate flowers and the soft, soothing touch of a mother's hand. The name Jawfiya carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawfiya usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to be a source of pride and joy for her family and community. It is a name that signifies excellence and nobility.
data.etymology: Jawfiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawfiya total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
